agency_th: กรุงเทพมหานคร — ประชุมออนไลน์ผู้ว่าฯ กทม. ร่วมนายกรัฐมนตรี 26 ก.ย. 2569 16:15
url_search_note: Pasted maintainer summary of the 16:15 online meeting between the BMA governor and the Prime Minister -- no direct bangkok.go.th/prbangkok.go.th/official Facebook post URL located yet. url stays OPEN rather than substituting a news URL for an official one. Supersedes, does not contradict, the 13:00 briefing (bma_briefing_2026-09-26_1300.json) on the shared facts (backlog volume unchanged at 223 million m^3); numbers that changed between the two (shelters in-use, roads-affected count) are BOTH kept on record, tagged by their own briefing time, never silently overwritten.

backlog_volume_phra_nakhon_side.note: Unchanged from the 13:00 briefing's own figure -- stated again at 16:15, not a new measurement.

total_bma_pumping_capacity.note: Carried forward unchanged from the 13:00 briefing (bma_briefing_2026-09-26_1300.json) -- not restated as a new figure at 16:15, but needed here so build_data.py's drain-time arithmetic (which always reads the newest BRIEFING_PATH) keeps working off a real declared value rather than a hole.

estimated_drain_time_if_no_new_rain.note: Carried forward unchanged from the 13:00 briefing -- not restated as a new figure at 16:15.

main_canals_status.value: คลองสายหลักเต็ม บางจุดล้นตลิ่ง

main_roads_affected_count.note: Distinct metric from the 13:00 briefing's roads_affected_count (93, a broader road list) -- this 16:15 figure is specifically "main roads" (ถนนสายหลัก). Both kept, not merged.

shelters.note: in_use risen from 981 (13:00 briefing) to ~4,200 by 16:15.

households_affected_initial_survey.note: Described as an initial/preliminary survey figure (สำรวจเบื้องต้น), not final.

bedridden_patients_moved.note: Approximate (~40), rounded up slightly from the 13:00 briefing's 36 -- both kept on record.

health_support_ready.value: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 69 แห่ง + โรงพยาบาล กทม. 13 แห่ง พร้อมรองรับ
health_support_ready.value_en: 69 public health centres + 13 BMA hospitals ready

disaster_response_support.value: ปภ. และหน่วยทหารสนับสนุนรถสูง/เรือ เข้าพื้นที่ที่เข้าถึงยาก
disaster_response_support.value_en: DDPM (ปภ.) and military support with high-clearance trucks and boats for hard-to-reach areas

tmd_forecast_note.value: กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา (TMD): ฝนอาจยังตกหนัก 26 ก.ย. และมีแนวโน้มลดลงตั้งแต่ 27 ก.ย. เป็นต้นไป
tmd_forecast_note.note: Relayed from TMD via the BMA briefing -- this is TMD's own official forecast, distinct from the third-party Open-Meteo/multi-model forecast this page otherwise relies on. Shown next to (never replacing) the multi-model 7-day comparison table.

conditional_outlook.value: if no new rain, situation gradually improves (ทยอยคลี่คลาย)
